title: Highest risk actor
description: Determine which actor is associated with the highest overall risk exposure.
query: Which threat actor poses the greatest risk to the organisation based on the severity and frequency of their events?

title: Most vulnerable asset
description: Identify the asset most frequently impacted by risk events.
query: Which corporate asset is most at risk, and what types of threats has it been exposed to?

title: Insider vs external threat comparison
description: Compare the risk profile of insider threats versus external threat actors.
query: How do insider threats compare to external threats in terms of number of events and average risk score?

title: Ransomware blast radius
description: Assess the full impact of ransomware events across the organisation.
query: What is the total blast radius of ransomware attacks — which assets were affected and over what timeframe?

title: Attack escalation pattern
description: Identify whether events show a pattern of escalating attacks over time.
query: Is there evidence of attack escalation — are threat actors progressing from initial access techniques to more severe actions over time?

title: Source code risk assessment
description: Assess the risk exposure of source code assets across all threat vectors.
query: What are all the ways our source code repository has been threatened, and which actors and risk types were involved?

title: Unmitigated severe events
description: Identify severe risk events that have no incident response process assigned.
query: Are there any high-severity risk events that don't have an incident response process assigned yet? What should we prioritise?

title: Incident response bottlenecks
description: Identify which teams have the most incomplete process steps.
query: Which teams or individuals have the most outstanding incident response steps? Where are the bottlenecks in our mitigation workflows?
